hp001.name: Vit-Bar
hp001.description: Restores 20 HP to a single target.
hp001.lore: A nutritional bar used by many adventurers. Easy to carry but not tasty at all.

hp002.name: Vit-Drink
hp002.description: Restores 50 HP to a single target.
hp002.lore: A nutritional drink oft used by town folks, it is the primary ingredient of many potions.

hp003.name: Vit-Potion
hp003.description: Restores 120 HP to a single target.
hp003.lore: An enhanced Vit-Drink. It is the go-to item for town guards

mp001.name: Re-Mind Jelly
mp001.description: Restores 20 MP to a single target.
mp001.lore: Jelly used by scholars and children. Its sweetness will refresh the mind.

mp002.name: Re-Mind Drink
mp002.description: Restores 50 MP to a single target.
mp002.lore: Drink made from the extract of an exotic plant. Instantly refresh the mind
